Public Notices  

For more information on Simplifying Local Government >>

Thank you to everyone who attended our public meetings on the Simplifying Local Government reform. It was great to see so many community members come along, ask questions, and share their views.

If you weren't able to attend, or would like to watch the presentation again, the recording is now available online.

Council Meetings 2026

Risk and Assurance Committee Meeting: 1pm, Monday 3 August
Regulatory and Services Committee Meeting: 9am, Wednesday 12 August
Ordinary Council Meeting: 9am, Wednesday 26 August
Regulatory and Services Committee Meeting: 9am, Wednesday 16 September

Please note: The Public Forum is available before every formal meeting held by Council (Council Meeting, Regulatory and Services, Extraordinary meetings) for people who wish to raise issues directly with the team of Elected Members. Please arrive at least 10 minutes prior to the meeting start time to ensure you are signed in, you and the issue you are raising is logged on the run sheet and you are seated in the Council Chambers. Usual meeting protocols apply.  

Meetings are recorded and uploaded to the website and Social Media. By attending you give your consent to filming. People are asked to adhere to the Council Code of Conduct.

How can Council help?

Let us know about an issue or repair needed of a community walkway, footpath, road/s, tree/s, water, or concern about dog/s and/or noise:  

  • Phone 07 306 9009 (24/7) Press 1 for Noise and Dogs, Press 2 for the Duty Supervisor (water, trees etc)
  • Lodge a request via the Antenno App (if it's a roaming / barking / dog attack please take a photo if you safely can)
  • Email info@kaweraudc.govt.nz 
  • Use our fix-it form via the website here
